description: This file defines classes and methods for integrating project task work with timesheet entries in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including handling user-related details, creation, updating, and deletion of timesheet records linked to project tasks.

classes.name: project_work
classes.description: Extends project.task.work to integrate with timesheet entries, including creation, update, and deletion of linked timesheet records.

classes.name: task
classes.description: Extends project.task to handle cascading deletions and updates of related timesheet entries.

classes.name: project_project
classes.description: Extends project.project to customize display name with project category code.

methods.name: get_user_related_details
methods.description: Retrieves product, journal, account, and UOM details related to a user’s employee record, raising errors if configuration is incomplete.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new timesheet entry linked to a project task, calculating amounts based on hours and product price.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Updates existing timesheet entries when related task work or task details change.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes linked timesheet entries when task work or tasks are deleted.

methods.name: name_get
methods.description: Returns a display name for projects including category code.
